comparison.objective: Remove a screwdriver, latch a control box and switch its supply on safely; candidate screens finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool extraction, cover closure/latching and rocker actuation versus bimanual screen handling and granular-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: Tool released on table, cover latched shut, supply on and arms clear, with unsafe energization vetoed; candidate grades loading and media recovery with loss/contamination vetoes.
comparison.reason: Electrical closeout sequencing is unrelated to physical screening.
